issues.description: The UML/problem statement defines Ride.abbreviation as type char, but the solution code declares Ride.abbreviation as String and its constructor takes a String, while RollerCoaster's constructor in the solution uses a char parameter. This inconsistent typing for the same attribute between the specification and the solution (and within the solution itself) will confuse students and can cause compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abbreviation type consistent across the specification and code. Preferred fix: follow the UML and change Ride.abbreviation to char, update Ride constructor to (String name, char abbreviation) and getAbbreviation() to return char, and ensure all subclasses and constructors (e.g., RollerCoaster, LaunchedRollerCoaster) accept and forward a char. Alternatively, if String is intended, update the UML/problem statement to specify String for abbreviation and adjust all constructors/fields to use String.
